text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is Christmas. Naturally, I was planning on taking a break from training, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, can you hear the horn of the apocalypse, Trainer?!
The turf is calling to me! It wants to rendezvous on this silent night!!
choice_data_list: Huh... We have training again tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The endgame is near.
...Before it arrives, I must bring my greatest weapon, 'speed,'
even closer to eternity!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then tomorrow night. Here again.
Tanino Gimlet seems to be pushing herself too hard for the MC rotation. Considering her fatigue, I really want her to rest, but――

Fufun. Hear then my grand stratagem.
I have a plan to outwit that one!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin our Nativity celebration, Trainer!
First, a strategy meeting... wait, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas!
Happy holidays.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahahaha~! You fell for it,
Gimlet-dono! Training is canceled!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... you...
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! I just really wanted you to take a rest today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... a holiday—is a necessary thing.
In order to win."
choice_data_list: If you catch your breath, you'll be able to see the bigger picture!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look, I baked some mince pies!
Why don't we make a wish while eating them?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Pizza and cola for me! At times like this,
you just crave junk food, y'know~?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......Kh. Heheheh...
Hahaha... Bwaaaa-hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Scheming to drag out the god of the left eye, are we?!
Ah... ahh! That's just like you!
Spoken like my true sworn allies!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"With such boundless affection prepared for me,
how could I ever fail to respond!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright! From me to you—intoxication!
I'll show you all the brightest star in the frosty night sky!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you eating, Gimlet?!
There's seconds of my rolled omelet, too!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... You are quite considerate toward me tonight, aren't you?
What a rare alignment of the stars.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, it is what they call 'sending salt to the enemy'!
Though whether it is truly salt to you... I cannot say!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... You Judas Iscariot.
Is your true goal to bestow indolence upon me?
Or to sow confusion with your words?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Either way, you conquered Troy.
—In a manner quite fitting for a modern tactician.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, this tenacity... Maybe I could learn a thing or two from it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No goood. Memory is way too haaard.
Can we play something else next?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Fleeing from your own dilemma? Did you think I was unaware of why Achilles fell?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because what I'm bad at, I'm bad at!
Instead, I'll just do my best at what I'm good at!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. I see.
To acknowledge one's weakness is also a solution to a difficult problem, is it—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! What a delightful night! Not even the festivals of Dionysia could compare!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have also received a revelation! Know thyself—
How utterly foolish it is to seek eternity in "speed"!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Wise commanders say—be strong. Scholars say—love your weakness. Therefore, I say—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Stopping one's feet on Christmas is also a form of strength.
Accepting my own weakness is the very philosophy I must learn!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha... So I was the one swallowed by the abyss, was I?
Tonight's discussion—you were right.
choice_data_list: I'm glad... if I could be of any help at all

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my eyes are open.
Now—I can pursue my obsession without any reservations.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
To me, the Mile Championship rotation—is everything.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Everything that defines Tanino Gimlet.
Or perhaps, the wedge and chains that define who I am.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if the fires of hell should consume this body.
I will see it through. —That alone I will do.

"If that's the case, I will keep supporting her
so she doesn't burn herself out—
Secretly, that was the vow I made."
